brief:
Gaza's Health Ministry has issued a warning over surging meningitis cases in the territory, Shehab Wire reported. The ministry anticipates further increases as environmental conditions deteriorate and water and sewage infrastructure continues to sustain damage.

The warning reflects mounting public health pressures in Gaza, where repeated damage to sanitation systems has created conditions conducive to disease spread. Meningitis, a serious bacterial or viral infection of the membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord, poses particular risk in areas with compromised water systems.
